blockingIssues.problem: The description reframes the task as evaluating whether the facilities team should increase maintenance spending, which changes the communication job away from helping swimmers use the temporary entrance.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: Source: "Editorial task: help swimmers use the temporary pool entrance." and "The facilities team will separately consider maintenance spending; this notice is not that review."
blockingIssues.constraint: The source assigns the notice the job of informing swimmers how to use the temporary (west) entrance during the east entrance closure and explicitly separates out any maintenance‑spending review; the notice must not be presented as an evaluation of maintenance spending.
